definitions.explanation: Honorific form of いる, used to show respect toward the subject.
Honorific form of 来る or 行く.

notes:
いらっしゃる is an honorific (⟦{尊敬語|そんけいご}→尊敬語：17106_sonkeigo⟧) verb that replaces three common verbs when speaking respectfully about someone:

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: いらっしゃる

THREE MEANINGS:
- ⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ → いらっしゃる (to be, to exist)
- ⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ → いらっしゃる (to come)
- ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ → いらっしゃる (to go)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- いらっしゃいませ: Welcome! (shop greeting — imperative form)
- いらっしゃい: Welcome! (casual version)
- ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いらっしゃいます⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: Is the teacher here/available?

KEIGO TYPE:
⟦{尊敬語|そんけいご}→尊敬語：17106_sonkeigo⟧ — used to elevate the subject (the person you're talking about). Never use about yourself.
